name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_aux_param_edit_kill_focus
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::OnAuxParamEditKillFocus clamps the query aux parameter into the accepted WOL range and rewrites the edit text.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43f4d0 validates signed comparisons of m_queryAuxParam against 1 and 1000, SetWindowTextA of literal "1" with m_queryAuxParam = 1 for low values, SetWindowTextA of literal "1000" with m_queryAuxParam = 1000 for high values, and _ltoa(value, local 16-byte buffer, 10) followed by SetWindowTextA for in-range values.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_aux_param_edit_kill_focus_smoke patches SetWindowTextA and verifies the low clamp, high clamp, and in-range decimal formatting paths, including the m_queryAuxParam side effects.
